observation_method: Read-only inspection of the configured Codex MCP list and tool metadata. No Zoho records or configuration were read or changed.
publication_boundary: One row is retained for every advertised tool. Source server names, endpoints, credentials, organization IDs, record IDs, and cross-business configuration are intentionally omitted.
interpretation: Advertised means present in this session's tool metadata. Tool IDs can be generated and unstable. Presence does not prove current OAuth scope, target identity, callability, response completeness, safety, or suitability for Sylvara.
